name: Rite of Vision
label: Quest
description: The Rite of Vision is the spiritual climax of an ancient trial undertaken by young tauren in Bloodhoof Village. By drinking the sacred Water of the Seers…
intro: The Rite of Vision is the spiritual climax of an ancient trial undertaken by young tauren in Bloodhoof Village. By drinking the sacred Water of the Seers beside the tribal bonfire, initiates summon a spectral guide to lead them toward their destiny.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I now present you with the Water of the Seers.
When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.
At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....

clips.title: Completion
paras: Be not afraid, friend Highcloud. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
